feature: Local release history is available from the interface, with localized text and an English fallback
fix: HTTPS resources use verified public DNS addresses with every redirect checked; direct WebView networking is blocked and resource requests support GET and HEAD only
improvement: Release packages are checked for a complete signing configuration, exact APK contents and reproducible documentation
dependency: Add OkHttp 4.12.0 for controlled HTTPS resource loading

feature: Added a document outline, in-page search, persistent text zoom, and render-time syntax highlighting without enabling JavaScript
Added safe navigation to relative Markdown documents inside the host-authorized directory, with in-viewer history and anchor handling
Added Android printing / PDF export and bounded YAML front matter rendering
Added definition and inline Footnotes with sanitized bidirectional backlinks
improvement: Hardened explorer-action v1 Intent, URI, path, link, resource, HTML, and Footnotes validation while preserving the single-file read-only boundary
Added a checkable Roadmap, 4 synthetic-data real-device screenshots, and reproducible README / CHANGELOG generation for 10 languages
Build verification rejects accidental native dependencies and produces a JSON report
dependency: Migrated CommonMark from the legacy Atlassian 0.9.0 fork to the official Maven Central 0.30.0 core and extension modules, with core library desugaring for API 24
fix: Fixed primary previewer protocol rejection and settings crashes; synchronized the host appearance, page chrome, and monochrome dialog controls
Plugin enablement failing in the AutoJs6 plugin center because the service returned an empty binding (onNullBinding)
improvement: Streamlined the plugin name and description and unified the wording of user documentation across languages

feature: First release of Markdown Previewer: a `Markdown Previewer` overflow menu action for the AutoJs6 file manager that renders a single document read-only
Recognizes 10 extensions (md / markdown / mdown / mkd / mkdn / mdwn / mdtext / mdtxt / rmd / qmd) plus the `text/markdown` and `text/x-markdown` MIME types
Renders tables, task lists, strikethrough, automatic links, heading anchors, and in-document images
Ships GitHub (Auto / Light / Dark), Paper, and Sepia themes with custom CSS import, manual refresh, and fullscreen mode
Builds a read-only security sandbox with allowlist sanitization, CSP constraints, disabled JavaScript and storage, private address filtering, and input caps (Markdown 8 MiB, CSS 256 KiB)
Registers the plugin service through the `org.autojs.plugin.EXPLORER_ACTION` protocol and accesses the selected file and its parent directory via temporary host-granted content URIs
Localizes plugin metadata, UI, instructions, and documentation into Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong / Taiwan), English, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Arabic
